items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: Oh yeah Joe was something because he’s the champion of Count Basie and all the experiences.

ctx.x: Well actually you mentioned Joe Williams and he helped us get this project started that we’re doing.

Okay. Oh yeah Joe was something because he’s the champion of Count Basie and all the experiences. And then you know Joe Williams, he worked what I’d say more high class venues and rooms. So it was great. Because like you say he was with Count Basie and Vegas, he’s been everywhere.
Did you have any issues traveling with bands in — we’re talking let’s say the early 60s now, traveling around the country? What was that like?
